channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine air raid alert apps hit by cyberattacks after truce ends
item.description: Ukrainian users receive fake warnings of nuclear threats, while Moscow reports 'false information' on its app.

item.title: Nine die in ‘cataclysmic’ Florida business jet crash
item.description: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis tells reporters there appeared to be no casualties on the ground.

item.title: Iran war live: Tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump again says conflict to end soon
item.description: US president warns Iran to make a deal, as IRGC says two tankers have hit mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Kherson braces for return of war as localised Russia-Ukraine truce ends
item.description: Moscow and Kyiv continue strikes elsewhere, but no reported violations in Kherson region during the six-day ceasefire.

item.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
item.description: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.
